functions.name: task.list
functions.description: Lists the tasks of your session's project: id, title, description, status (open, doing, done), the session working on it and notes. Optional status filters. From another instance: name a shared project in project.

functions.name: task.add
functions.description: Adds an open task to your session's project, e.g. to split up work for other agents. Returns the task. From another instance: name a shared project in project.

functions.name: task.claim
functions.description: Takes an open task for your session (status doing). Fails if another session took it. When your session ends, its tasks become open again. From another instance: name a shared project in project.

functions.name: task.note
functions.description: Adds a progress note to a task of your project that no other session took. From another instance: name a shared project in project.

functions.name: task.done
functions.description: Marks a task done, with an optional closing note. Fails if another session took it. From another instance: name a shared project in project.
